Reviewed comparator: Majhi jibro “tongue” (f_4bpw36n72gjcw). Uncertain intra-IA transmission remains open; exact source text is preserved. These spider forms fit that family, distinct from the similar monkey head. Reviewed comparison: DewasDoneDanuwar makuri “spider” (f_pmegns4vcvou6). Possible intra-IA transfer remains open; source forms and provenance are preserved. The present source form was inspected for phonetic and gloss differences; normalization was used only to find it, and its exact spelling is preserved.
